Meta.title: Nyuppsättning
Meta.description: Support for steering groups reviving Chalmersspex productions

Home.title: Nyuppsättning
Home.mustBeLoggedIn: You need to log in to use Nyuppsättning.
Home.empty: You hold no role in a revival that is visible right now.

NoAccess.title: You do not have access
NoAccess.text: Your FGV account does not have access to Nyuppsättning. Ask a super admin for access.

LoginError.title: Login failed
LoginError.text: Something went wrong while logging in. Please try again.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.text: The page or revival does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

Admin.title: All revivals
Admin.manageDirecteursDescription: Appoint directeurs by email address or remove them. The steering group is managed on the revival's page.
Admin.readOnly: You can see every revival but not change them.

CreateDialog.title: New revival
CreateDialog.description: Pick the spex in Spexregister and enter year and working title.
CreateDialog.spexregisterUnavailable: Spexregister is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

Members.confirmRemoveText: The person loses their role in the revival. The change is kept in the history.
Members.noMembers: The steering group has no members.

Errors.CONFLICT: Someone else has changed this. Reload and try again.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
Errors.SPEXREGISTER_UNAVAILABLE: Spexregister is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
Errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Validation.yearRange: The year must be between 1948 and 2100.
Validation.workingTitleTooLong: The working title must be at most 255 characters.
Validation.premiereYear: The premiere must be in the revival's year.
Validation.showDateBeforePremiere: A show must not be before the premiere.
Validation.showDateWithoutPremiere: Set the premiere date before shows.
Validation.venueBlank: A venue must not be empty.
Validation.labelRequired: Enter a version label, e.g. v6.
Validation.suggestionContentRequired: Suggest a new text or a new type.

About.title: About
About.heading: About Nyuppsättning
About.description: Nyuppsättning is provided by FGV to support the steering groups that put on a Chalmersspex again, from proposal to archiving.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, are you having trouble logging in, or are you missing access to a revival? We are happy to help you sort it out.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

CommandPalette.title: Command palette
CommandPalette.description: Jump to a page or start an action

Guide.title: The guide
Guide.notPublished: The guide has not been published yet.

admin.title: Manage the guide
admin.untranslated: {count, plural, =0 {everything is translated} one {# text has no English} other {# texts have no English}}

import.title: Import the guide from Word
import.description: The document becomes a draft that you review before publishing it. This is only possible before the guide is first published.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large. At most 10 MB.

warning.UNKNOWN_LABEL: “{detail}” is not a known label, so the items under it became text.

publish.title: Publish the draft
publish.description: A published version can never be changed. Revivals without a version are pinned to it.
publish.label: Version label

discard.title: Discard the draft?
discard.description: The draft and every change in it are removed. Published versions are not affected.
discard.reopens: {count, plural, one {# accepted suggestion reopens.} other {# accepted suggestions reopen.}}

Guide.refused: The guide is shown to the steering groups and directeurs of running revivals, and to FGV/JK.

version.changeDescription: The revival now follows {label}. See what changes before you switch.
version.changed: The revival follows the new version
version.newer: There is a newer version of the guide, {label}.

suggest.description: Your suggestion goes to FGV/JK, who decide whether it goes into the next version of the guide.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.reopened: The draft this was accepted into was discarded, so the suggestion is open again.
suggestions.accepted: The suggestion is accepted and in the draft
suggestions.conflict: The item has changed in the draft since the suggestion was made. Choose what the draft gets.
suggestions.goneFromDraft: The item is no longer in the draft.
